Then pass THROUGH that open exterior arch into the same sunlit stone courtyard. 5-10 seconds: widen the river valley with classical stone architecture and follow the flowing river toward a small stone bridge. True perspective parallax, smooth physically plausible camera, stable stonework, stable books, realistic wind in leaves and continuous water motion.
